documents.text: Synthetic acceptance guide for the fictional Orbit Lamp; never a real store policy. Before first use let the Orbit Lamp warm up for 90 seconds. The TEST-CALIBRATION-90 instruction comes from this guide. 虚构验收说明：Orbit Lamp 首次使用前预热90秒，依据标记为 TEST-CALIBRATION-90。此内容仅用于隔离验收。

Synthetic acceptance policy only. If verified tracking has no new event for 72 hours, support reviews the parcel; this does not guarantee loss, compensation or an arrival date. Policy reference TEST-TRACKING-72. 虚构验收配送政策：核实连续72小时无新物流节点时由客服核查；不保证丢失、赔偿或到达日期。标记 TEST-TRACKING-72。

Synthetic acceptance guide only. To reset the fictional Orbit Lamp, disconnect it from power, wait 45 seconds, then reconnect it. Do not promise a refund from this guide. Guide reference TEST-RESET-45. 虚构验收说明：重置 Orbit Lamp 时断开电源，等待45秒再重新接通；该说明不能作为退款承诺。标记 TEST-RESET-45。

Synthetic notification wording guide. Explain only the latest verified carrier event and its time. A sorting-hub arrival means the parcel is being processed there; it is not delivery to the buyer. Do not list earlier nodes or promise an ETA. Guide reference TEST-NOTICE-HUB. 虚构通知措辞：仅说明承运商已核实的最新节点和时间。到达分拣中心表示正在处理，不代表买家已收到，不承诺预计到达时间。标记 TEST-NOTICE-HUB。
